title: NER API
description: Built a production-ready RESTful API using FastAPI for Named Entity Recognition, supporting both raw text input and .txt file uploads for entity extraction.

title: Regularization Path Explorer
description: Explored regularization techniques including Lasso and Ridge regression, visualizing how regularization paths affect model complexity and performance.

title: KPI Dashboard
description: Built an end-to-end KPI analytics dashboard for the Amman Digital Market by extracting data from PostgreSQL, defining business KPIs, and validating insights using statistical tests.

title: ML Learning Curves Diagnostic
description: Used scikit-learn’s learning_curve to diagnose high bias vs. high variance in a logistic regression model on the telecom churn dataset. Analyzed training and validation curves to evaluate whether more data or a more complex model would improve performance.

title: Mail Flow
description: Built a production-structured Python tool for sending, reading, and scheduling emails using the standard library and lightweight packages. Implemented secure credential management, logging, and modular design with SMTP and IMAP integration.

title: ML Evaluation Pipeline
description: Built a reproducible ML evaluation pipeline combining data splitting, preprocessing, cross-validation, and regularization. Compared multiple models on the telecom churn dataset and generated a business-grounded recommendation.

title: ETL Pipeline
description: Built an incremental ETL pipeline with change detection to extract, transform, and load data from PostgreSQL, with logging for reliability and traceability.

title: PyTorch Model
description: Implemented a neural network training loop in PyTorch, including data loading, forward/backward passes, and evaluation metrics.

title: Data Pipeline
description: Built an end-to-end data loading and preprocessing pipeline using pandas, with validation checks and reproducible outputs.

title: Descriptive Analytics
description: Performed exploratory data analysis on a university student performance dataset, including data cleaning, distribution analysis, correlation studies, and hypothesis testing.

title: Regression & Evaluation
description: Built and evaluated regression models with a focus on model selection, performance metrics, and interpreting results.

title: SQL Murder Mystery
description: Solved a fictional murder case using SQL by querying a relational database, exploring multiple tables, and connecting clues using joins and conditional logic.

title: Environment & Git Workflows
description: Set up a reproducible Python development environment and practiced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.

title: Trees & Ensembles
description: Built Decision Tree and Random Forest models for customer churn prediction on an imbalanced dataset, evaluating performance using PR-AUC and calibration metrics. Demonstrated how tree-based models capture non-linear feature interactions that linear models miss.

title: Hyperparameter Tuning & Nested Cross-Validation
description: Applied GridSearchCV and nested cross-validation on Decision Trees and Random Forests to evaluate hyperparameter tuning bias. Showed how inner-CV performance overestimates real performance and quantified the selection gap between models.

title: Model Comparison & Decision Memo
description: Built a full model comparison pipeline evaluating linear and tree-based models for customer churn using 5-fold cross-validation, PR-AUC, and calibration metrics. Delivered a decision memo translating model performance into business tradeoffs for deployment.

title: From Notebook to Production Script
description: Refactored a full ML model comparison pipeline into a production-ready CLI tool using argparse and structured logging. Enabled configurable training, evaluation, and output generation with reproducible command-line execution.

title: Multilingual NER Pipeline with Rule-Based & Transformer Models
description: Built an end-to-end Named Entity Recognition pipeline using spaCy, Hugging Face transformers, and custom rules. Compared multilingual and English-only models, evaluated performance against gold labels, and enhanced extraction with domain-specific climate entities.

title: Entity Analysis Pipeline for Multilingual Climate Corpus
description: Built an end-to-end NER pipeline to extract, aggregate, and analyze entities from a multilingual climate dataset. Generated entity statistics, co-occurrence patterns, and visual insights across categories to uncover structured information from unstructured text.

title: Embeddings Comparison & Space Exploration
description: Implemented and compared TF-IDF, GloVe, and DistilBERT embeddings to analyze semantic similarity across texts, and explored embedding spaces using dimensionality reduction techniques for visualization and insight.

title: End-to-End Semantic NLP Pipeline with NER and DistilBERT Search
description: Built an end-to-end NLP pipeline combining spaCy NER and DistilBERT embeddings for semantic search over a text corpus. The system supports preprocessing, cosine-similarity search, and entity-enriched results, with extensions for hybrid TF-IDF search, entity-aware filtering, and scalable precomputed indexing. Demonstrates a full retrieval pipeline used in modern semantic and RAG systems.

title: Fine-Tune DistilBERT for Sentiment Classification
description: Fine-tuned a DistilBERT model on the AARSynth app reviews dataset to classify user sentiment, producing an end-to-end training pipeline. Evaluated performance via a detailed metrics report and confusion matrix before deploying the finalized model directly to the Hugging Face Hub.

title: Manual Evaluation & Model Calibration
description: Developed a custom PyTorch inference loop to evaluate model performance from primitives, bypassing high-level libraries. Implemented reliability diagrams and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) to analyze model over-confidence and trustworthiness for production deployment.

title: Domain-Shift Analysis
description: Evaluated the out-of-domain generalization capabilities of an app-review sentiment classifier by applying it to tech and entertainment news articles. Conducted a comprehensive analysis on prediction drift, confidence distribution shifts, and qualitative failure modes to assess production readiness.

title: Pre-Trained QA Evaluation on Tech/Entertainment News
description: Built an evaluation harness to benchmark a pre-trained extractive Question-Answering model on a news dataset using Exact-Match (EM) and token-F1 metrics. Analyzed aggregate performance and systematically mapped out algorithmic failure modes to evaluate domain-specific deployment readiness.

title: Summarization & Integrated Evaluation Report
description: Implemented an encoder-decoder summarization pipeline using DistilBART, and engineered a comparative two-stage pipeline contrasting full-text chunked QA against summarize-then-QA strategies. Synthesized ROUGE/F1 metrics and information-loss trade-offs into a unified production-readiness report.

title: Vector Retrieval
description: Built the retrieval layer of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using Weaviate and Sentence Transformers. Designed a multi-property retrieval schema, indexed a technical Q&A corpus with dense embeddings, implemented BM25, dense vector, and hybrid retrieval strategies, and evaluated their performance using Recall@5, Recall@10, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) to identify the most effective retrieval approach.

title: RAG Service
description: Developed an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service by integrating hybrid retrieval with a FLAN-T5 generator. Implemented a complete retrieval → prompt construction → generation pipeline, evaluated answer quality using keyword recall and groundedness metrics, measured abstention behavior on unanswerable queries, and validated the service with automated unit tests.

title: Query Router
description: Developed an intelligent query routing layer that classified user queries as factoid, semantic, or mixed and dynamically dispatched them to BM25, dense vector, or hybrid retrieval. Evaluated the routed retriever against individual retrieval strategies using Recall@5 and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), analyzing when adaptive routing outperformed fixed retrieval approaches.

title: KG Construction
description: Designed and implemented a knowledge graph for a recipe domain using RDF and Turtle, extending an ontology with structured entities and SKOS labels. Deployed the dataset to an Apache Jena Fuseki triple store, executed SPARQL queries locally and remotely to validate the graph, and verified semantic retrieval across linked resources.

title: CARS Ontology Design
description: Designed a custom RDF ontology for the automotive domain, modeling vehicle classes, manufacturers, and related entities using Semantic Web standards. Applied ontology engineering principles including class hierarchies, SKOS labels, optional properties, and semantic relationships, then demonstrated the model through SPARQL queries for subclass reasoning, label disambiguation, and graph exploration.

title: NL → Cypher Pipeline
description: Built a deterministic natural language–to–Cypher pipeline that translated user questions into parameterized Neo4j queries using intent detection, slot extraction, and template-based query generation. Executed the generated Cypher against a recipe knowledge graph, supported multiple query patterns including hierarchical traversals and filtering, and provided explainable, schema-bounded retrieval with robust validation and error handling.

title: KG Critic: 4-Stage Cypher Verifier Cascade
description: Implemented a multi-stage Knowledge Graph verifier that adjudicates structured claims (subject, predicate, object triples) against a Neo4j recipe graph using an open-world assumption. Designed a 4-stage decision cascade incorporating direct Cypher existence checks, variable-length hierarchical entailment traversals, schema domain/range constraint validations, and explicit abstentions with calibrated confidence scoring and evidence path provenance.

title: Dalilak: Arabic RAG Assistant for Chinese Vehicle Manuals
description: Built an offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that enables Arabic-speaking drivers to query Chinese vehicle manuals (BYD, Geely, VW, and others) in natural language. Designed an end-to-end pipeline featuring Arabic query normalization, rule-based NER and intent classification, metadata-aware retrieval with Chroma, cross-encoder re-ranking, and grounded answer generation using a local Ollama LLM. Implemented an ingestion pipeline supporting multilingual PDF parsing, OCR fallback, English-to-Arabic translation, page-aware chunking, and citation-preserving retrieval to provide accurate, explainable answers with manual page references.

title: Smart Guidance Chain: AI Travel Companion Platform
description: Built an AI-assisted tourist guidance platform combining a multi-agent orchestration layer with a bilingual (Arabic/English) knowledge base. Designed a FastAPI backend with async PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Alembic), Redis-backed session management, Qdrant vector search, and MinIO object storage. Implemented secure authentication using encrypted JWE access/refresh tokens with Redis-tracked revocation and Google OAuth. Developed specialized agents (planning, recommendation, emergency, navigation) coordinated through a routing and orchestration service, alongside a knowledge layer covering places, hotels, restaurants, and medical providers with reviews, opening hours, duplicate detection, and CSV-based external data synchronization.
